text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Multiple container restarts detected on inference-prod-us-west-2. Reason: GPU OOM during prefill (large context inputs). ~18 restarts in last 10m, autoscaler muted.

sre-oncall: I'm taking this. Confirming scope — are these only prefill tasks or generation as well?

emma: seeing large-context / long-prompt traffic from a single customer stream (stream-47). Prefill kernels show spike to 48k tokens.

raj: putting a temp route block on that customer to stop new sessions. Doing: `rbac route disable --customer stream-47 --cluster us-west-2`

infra-ops: copy of the recent container logs: ```
[2026-03-17T02:10:12Z] ERROR: Allocation failed: CUDA OOM when allocating 2048 MiB
[2026-03-17T02:10:12Z] INFO: Prefill len=48200 tokens, model=redwood-7b-quant
[2026-03-17T02:10:13Z] CRIT: Process killed (OOM) -> container restart
```

sre-oncall: thanks. Quick mitigations: 1) drain problematic node, 2) enable prefill token cap on the runtime, 3) route excess to fallback smaller model. Who can apply caps now?

emma: I can push a runtime flag to cap prefill_length=32k for the cluster. Will stage to one pool first.

raj: I applied the customer block and created fallback routing: requests over 32k get sent to redwood-2b-fallback. Command: `redwood route update --max-prefill 32000 --fallback redwood-2b-fallback`

infra-ops: draining node gpu-node-24 now. `kubectl drain gpu-node-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` — taking ~30s.

cust-ops: any visible customer impact? We have a live stream reporting tokenization lag and occasional 502s since ~02:08. Notifying affected account support.

sre-oncall: ETA on caps rollout?

emma: rolling to 20% of pods in us-west-2 canary now. If stable for 2m, promote.

infra-ops: drain complete, node cordoned. No further restarts on that node in the last 60s.

sre-oncall: good. After canary, promote cluster-wide and leave fallback routing for 10m. Also create a short-term alert to watch failed prefill retries.

raj: created alert: `prefill.oom.rate > 0.05 for 1m` -> pager.

cust-ops: notifying the customer that we've throttled long-context runs and enabled a fallback to preserve availability.

emma: can we investigate why autoscaler muted? looks like scale-down protection? Scheduling a postmortem.

sre-oncall: agreed — file for incident-review and include kernel allocation traces and the offending request IDs (found in logs). For now, I'm closing the live pager — mitigation in place. Please continue monitoring for next 30m. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Pager resolved: mitigation applied, no new restarts for 5m. Incident ticket: INC-20260317-1023
